title: The Nine send Puharich and Schlemmer to Egypt, Middle East and Russia

tellings.quote: in that time, they're getting messages from the nine saying, you know, you need to go to Egypt, you need to go to you know, any,

plain: Between 1974 and 1976, a group calling itself "the Nine", said to be non-human intelligences speaking through recorded sessions, reportedly told the researcher Andrija Puharich and the medium Phyllis Schlemmer to travel to Egypt, the Middle East and Russia. A guest on Michels' show, who is not named, tells this as a summary drawn from Puharich's session tapes, the recordings of those sessions, and also names a man called John Whitmore. If true, it would mean the messages were directing real journeys around the world.
